influences.context: For example, "(I Can't Get No) Satisfaction" was written by Keith Richards, according to him, within a matter of minutes.

influences.name: Paul McCartney
influences.context: Apparently, Paul McCartney wrote "Yesterday" in five minutes or so. I think that pop music has a sense of urgency

influences.name: Molly Gerber

influences.name: Chris Hendrix
influences.context: Chris Hendrix is a Berklee grad with a swiss army knife of a skill set, and gave me the confidence to write those types of arrangements with them

influences.name: Björk
influences.context: I'm really obsessed with artist's discographies. Not that I even deign to compare myself to her in any way, but Björk's catalog is just so perfect to me.

influences.name: Wilco
influences.context: An artist's third album should be a big statement... including Wilco's Summerteeth, when an artist is at the top of their game and anything feels possible.

influences.name: Kate Bush
influences.context: I was listening to a lot of Kate Bush at the time... So I was really inspired by the greats ... like Kate Bush. I think it's really amazing that she's someone who has such massive appeal but is, like, the biggest freak and has the most surreal, bizarre lyrics and has this really strange, proggy instrumentation. So I was really influenced by Kate Bush on this record and leaned towards surreal lyrics a little bit more on 'Paprika.'

influences.name: Susumu Hirasawa
influences.context: I called it 'Paprika' because it reminded me of this Susumu Hirasawa song called 'Parade' that's in the movie Paprika.

influences.name: Mitski
influences.context: Mitski told me she was doing these kind of writing partnerships, writing for other people just to try it on, and so I told my publisher that I wanted to try it.

influences.name: Whitney Houston
influences.context: We actually wrote something that I really liked and had this kind of '80s jam -- a Whitney Houston, Madonna, Cyndi Lauper kind of feel

influences.name: Alex G

influences.name: Little Big League
influences.context: I see this song as a kind of parallel to the Little Big League song 'Lindsey,' where it's written from this toxic male perspective

influences.name: Randy Newman
influences.context: I knew it was such a tender song and I wanted it to be this Randy Newman ballad with big, sweeping strings. I was really influenced by 'Marie,' which is one of my favorite Randy Newman songs.

influences.name: Bill Withers
influences.context: Craig was like, 'I really hear this Bill Withers sort of feel'... And he put down this drum beat and the bass line... I think the combination of those two influences really made it such a special song

influences.name: Fiona Apple
influences.context: When I was putting the vocal down, it felt almost like a Fiona Apple song because I feel like that's her influence -- she had those funky, jazzy elements with piano.

influences.name: Roy Orbison
influences.context: So Craig and I really turned it into this Roy Orbison-esque, girl group, big Motown swelling chorus kind of song.
